title: A crew roster that solves the same way twice

blocks.text: A vegetation-management contractor rosters its tree-trimming crews with CP-SAT. The roster must be reproducible: the same data and the same three numbers from the run's manifest (seed, worker count, amount of work) must give the same roster on any rerun on the same OR-Tools version.

Write `configure(solver, seed, workers, work)`. It sets the parameters of the given `CpSolver` so that a run with those three numbers repeats, whether `workers` is 1 or more, and returns the solver. `work` is the deterministic amount of work at which the search stops. Leave every other parameter at its default.

"""Run executes this file. Change the calls and see what prints. Submit grades."""
import logging

# Turn the logger up, so the `log.debug` lines of your code show under the printed lines.
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")

from ortools.sat.python import cp_model

from roster_solver import configure

# Two crews, four parks; each park mown by one crew; a crew mows at most two.
model = cp_model.CpModel()
x = {(p, c): model.new_bool_var(f"x_{p}_{c}") for p in range(4) for c in range(2)}
for p in range(4):
    model.add_exactly_one(x[p, c] for c in range(2))
for c in range(2):
    model.add(sum(x[p, c] for p in range(4)) <= 2)
model.maximize(sum((p + 2) * (c + 1) % 4 * x[p, c] for p in range(4) for c in range(2)))

solver = configure(cp_model.CpSolver(), seed=23, workers=2, work=3.0)
print("seed:", solver.parameters.random_seed)
print("workers:", solver.parameters.num_workers)
print("work limit:", solver.parameters.max_deterministic_time)
print("interleave search:", solver.parameters.interleave_search)
status = solver.solve(model)
print("status:", solver.status_name(status), "objective:", solver.objective_value)
